description: Translation with Yandex Cloud - translate passages between languages, detect the language of text, and list the supported languages.

api.description: Detect the language of each passage, one result per entry and in order

fields.description: The Yandex Cloud folder to bill and scope the call to. Required with a user account's IAM token; leave it out with a service-account API key or IAM token, which use the service account's folder.

api.description: List the supported languages, with their codes and display names

fields.description: The Yandex Cloud folder to bill and scope the call to. Required with a user account's IAM token; leave it out with a service-account API key or IAM token, which use the service account's folder.

fields.type: { code?: string | null, name?: string | null }[] | null

api.description: Translate up to 1,000 passages into a target language, detecting the source per passage when it is not given

fields.description: The language to translate into, such as `ru` or `en`.
The passages to translate. Each is translated separately.
The source language. Omit to detect it.
How the text is interpreted. Defaults to PLAIN_TEXT.
The Yandex Cloud folder to bill and scope the call to. Required with a user account's IAM token; leave it out with a service-account API key or IAM token, which use the service account's folder.
